en.headline: The Weeknd opens four-night Kai Tak Stadium run tonight
en.dek: The Canadian artist begins the Hong Kong leg of his After Hours Til Dawn tour at Kai Tak Stadium, with shows continuing over the next two weekends.
body: Canadian singer The Weeknd is scheduled to perform the first of four concerts at Kai Tak Stadium this evening as part of the final leg of his After Hours Til Dawn world tour.

Organisers said security checks open from 4pm, with the show starting at 8:15pm. Additional dates are set for 25, 30 and 31 October at the same venue. The performances mark his return to Hong Kong stages after an eight-year gap.

Tickets for general admission start from HK$808, with VIP packages available at higher prices. Standing areas are restricted to those aged 12 and above and at least 140cm tall. The stadium has published admission guidance including gate assignments and merchandise arrangements.

zh.headline: The Weeknd今晚在啟德主場館展開四晚巡演
zh.dek: 加拿大歌手在啟德主場館開始After Hours Til Dawn巡演香港站，未來兩個周末繼續演出。
body: 加拿大歌手The Weeknd今晚將在啟德主場館舉行After Hours Til Dawn世界巡演香港站的首場演出，共安排四場。
主辦單位表示，安檢站由下午4時開放，演出於晚上8時15分開始。其餘場次定於10月25日、30日及31日同場地舉行。這是他相隔8年後再次在香港舞台演出。
一般門票由808港元起，VIP套票另設較高價位。企位區域只限12歲或以上及身高不少於140厘米人士。場館已公布入場指引，包括閘口分配及周邊商品安排。
